# Feature: Timed Match Countdown UI

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-02 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent
For **Zeit** matches: match mm:ss countdown (footer-like glitch → fly-up into AppShell header, countdown only after dock) plus a **60s per-turn** clock beside it („Du“ / „Gegner“). Pause freezes both; turn expiry force-skips via legal engine actions; match expiry still awards higher LP.

## Preconditions
- Play → Gegen Bot → Spieleinstellungen → Match-Ende **Zeit** (minutes set)
- Partie gestartet through MatchIntro + opening deal + turn-start announce
- Phase-coach footer completes dock (`phase-coach-footer` docked)

## Happy Path
- [ ] After footer docks in Zeit mode, center overlay glitches in (`data-testid="match-timer-announce"`, `data-timer-reveal="glitch"`) showing full starting mm:ss (frozen)
- [ ] Timer flies up (`data-timer-reveal="fly"`) with the same cadence/style as phase-coach-footer dock, then lands in header
- [ ] Match countdown starts only after header dock (`data-testid="app-match-timer"`); no drain during center/fly
- [ ] Beside match timer: per-turn clock (`data-testid="app-turn-timer"`) labeled **Du** or **Gegner**, counting **60 → 0**
- [ ] Turn clock resets to 60 when clock owner changes (`activePlayer` or defense/reaction actor)
- [ ] At turn 0: active turn ends via legal pass/skip/END_TURN path; opponent becomes active
- [ ] AppNav Pause **or** presentation input-lock freezes match + turn countdown; resume when clear
- [ ] At match 0:00, existing timeout resolves (higher LP wins / draw on equal LP)
- [ ] Standard match mode never shows center or header timers

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Reduced motion: center announce skips to header dock; countdown still starts only then
- [ ] Leaving/ending match clears header timers
- [ ] Soft pause during announce still freezes clocks once armed (pause applied at header dock)
- [ ] Turn expiry during combat/pending uses PASS_BLOCK / PASS_PENDING only (does not end attacker turn)
- [ ] Defense/reaction window gets a fresh 60s; header „Du“/„Gegner“ follows acting player

## Regression
- [ ] Footer glitch→fly→dock spectacle unchanged
- [ ] AppNav pause still stops bot auto-play
- [ ] Timed expiry via applyAction still works with pause accounting

## Assumptions
- Match clock arms when timer docks in the AppBrand header; turn clock starts with the same arm
- Announce timings mirror PhaseCoachFooter: 40ms delay + 520ms glitch + 400ms fly-up
- German UI: „Zeit“, „Du“, „Gegner“
